v: After this, Jesus crossed to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias).
A large crowd followed Him because they saw the signs He was performing on the sick.
Then Jesus went up on the mountain and sat down with His disciples.
Now the Jewish Feast of the Passover was near.
When Jesus looked up and saw a large crowd coming toward Him, He said to Philip, “Where can we buy bread for these people to eat?”
But He was asking this to test him, for He knew what He was about to do.
Philip answered, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to have a small piece.”
One of His disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to Him,
“Here is a boy with five barley loaves and two small fish. But what difference will these make among so many?”
“Have the people sit down,” Jesus said. Now there was plenty of grass in that place, so the men sat down, about five thousand of them.
Then Jesus took the loaves and the fish, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted.
And when everyone was full, He said to His disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over, so that nothing will be wasted.”
So they collected them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
When the people saw the sign that Jesus had performed, they began to say, “Truly this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
Then Jesus, realizing that they were about to come and make Him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by Himself.

paras: One day Jesus and His closest followers got in a boat and tried to go off to a quiet place to get some rest. But a large crowd of about 5,000 men and their families saw them and met them at their destination.

When Jesus saw the crowd, He was filled with compassion because they were like sheep without purpose and direction in life and they needed a shepherd. So, He began teaching them many things about God.
As it started getting late in the day, Jesus' closest followers came up to Him and said, "We need to send everyone away so they can go get something to eat."
Jesus said, "You give something to eat." And they were like, "With what? Do you know how much money it would cost to buy this many people food?!"
And Jesus replied, "Well, go and see how much bread you can find." So, they came back and told Him, "We have 5 loaves of bread and 2 fish, that's it."

Then Jesus took the bread and fish and thanked God for them. And He began breaking the bread into pieces and started handing them to the closest followers to give to the people. And He kept handing it to them and handing it to them and it just never ran out. And then in the same way He divided up the fish and gave everyone fish to eat.
And out of those 5 loaves of bread and 2 fish, the thousands of people there ate as much as they wanted and even had lots of leftovers.
